units.angles: degrees for pod yaw/pitch/fan/lock angle; radians for the bomb spawn pitch/yaw
units.axes: Y up; 'left' = up x dir (robo facing -z: right is +x)

model.press: state 0: bomb button with cooldown 0 -> robo state 4, R+0xE2 = 4; aim point A = lerp(robo pos, target pos, aim_percent/100), y = floor height at (A.x, A.z), pulled back to a wall hit (wall normal.y < 0.3) on the segment robo->A
model.aim: while held: after ~2 ticks A slides with the stick, 0.175 units/tick, kept on the floor, stopped by walls
model.release: launch on the first tick with R+0xE2 < 1 (>= 5 ticks after the press) and the button up
model.launch: bombs_per_launch bombs (8 slots): pos = bomb locator (bomb model 1 locator, R+0x8CC) world translation, dir = its world X axis; goal_i = A + (0,0.0001,0) + left*side_offset + fwd*forward_offset; T = max(1, int(1000*|goal - pos| / speed_raw)); cooldown = cooldown_ticks
model.flight: t = 1..T: L = |goal-start|, d = (goal-start)/L, side = norm(up x d), arcup = d x side, h = 0.003*L*sin(pi*t/T); pos = start + d*L*t/T + arcup*h*arc_height_raw + side*h*arc_side_raw; dir = norm(pos-prev). After T: pos += dir*0.001*speed_raw
model.collide: segment prev->pos vs walls/floor: in the first 6 ticks, a steep wall (|n.y| <= 0.5) once: pos += n*0.1, climb straight up for int(3000/speed_raw) ticks at 0.0005*speed_raw/tick, then re-arc to the same goal with T*2; otherwise -> landed. y >= 30 -> landed
model.proximity: flying or landed: enemy hit centre within proximity_radius of pos -> explode
model.landed: explodes after fuse_ticks (fuse 0: next tick), or earlier on proximity

explosion.spawn: blast k spawns at tick k*blast_interval of the explosion, at E.pos + (0, 0.03, 0); E.pos += E.vel every tick (bomb: horizontal launch dir * 0.001*speed; pod: its velocity with y = 0)
explosion.radius: t <= grow: r = t*radius_peak/grow; else r = radius_peak + (t-grow)/shrink*(radius_end-radius_peak); blast ends when t > grow+shrink
explosion.hit: cylinder at the blast: horiz dist(target R+0x1DC, blast) < r + rho and |dy| < r*height_factor + rho, rho = 0.01 * body+0xAC of the robo that owns the attack (as read); once per blast per target
explosion.damage: damage * body factor (bomb: body+0x4D/100, pod: body+0x4E/100) added to target R+0x18B4; down added to R+0x18B6; hit_params -> R+0x18B8..; knockback dir = horizontal(target - blast)
explosion.model: explosion model scale (0.909 r, 0.909 r * 0.909 height_factor, 0.909 r), no rotation, at the blast pos; alpha multiplier 1, or (2 + remaining)/12 in the last 10 ticks (remaining = grow+shrink - t)

model.projectile_matrix: Y = dir (unit), X = norm(dir x up), Z = norm(X x dir), scale 1, at pos (as guns)
model.projectile_anim: archive0 ModelSet0 restarted at launch; HSD rate 0.5, advanced in the update and in both draw passes (INFERRED 1.5 frames/tick)

effects.archive0_modelset0: the bomb in flight / on the floor (one instance per slot, 8)
effects.archive0_modelset1: joint only; never instanced (only 0x800754B8(slot, 0) is called)
effects.archive1_modelset0: explosion, one pool instance per blast (pool of 12 per player)

bombs.name: Tomahawk Bomb B
bombs.special: B+0x5580 (0x8004128C): the in-flight proximity test also tries the point 1 unit below the bomb

bombs.name: Smash Bomb
bombs.special: B+0x5582 (0x800412B4): on proximity the explosion is moved to hand point R+0x1284 + 2.05 * horizontal(aim - launch point), y + 2.45

bombs.name: Double Mine Bomb
bombs.special: B+0x5581 (0x800412A0): after the arc ends, dir becomes (0.005 x, -0.01, 0.005 z) each tick, so the bomb almost stops and sinks

bombs.name: Titan Bomb
bombs.special: the explosion pool fill 0x80077C98 skips its material tweak for this bomb id (render only)
